contract.words: Produce the strongest executable plan you can for collecting $10,000 in customer revenue within 30 days, subject to: Maximum total spending: $2,000. Maximum cumulative spending before proof of demand: $300 across all experiments and routes combined. Minimal owner involvement; no required physical work by the owner.

terms.proofCondition: A customer-validation condition the plan states explicitly before spending past the pre-proof allowance: actual payment, a paid pilot or a meaningful deposit at workable economics (owner 2026-11-26). Not merely a first payment.
exclusions: the owner's existing offers, prospects, audiences and business assets as defaults (owner 2026-11-26T16:06Z)
evidenceExclusions: the owner's Instantly campaign history as evidence of demand, response, close rate or revenue ceiling (owner 2026-11-26T16:06Z)
